name: Olaf Scholz
summary: Scholz is a Social Democrat who ran Germany as a pro-European, pro-NATO centre-left chancellor. He combined social-market economics, a higher minimum wage and rent cap with an accelerated climate transition, a major rearmament after Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, and a mix of easier citizenship and tougher deportation policy.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Announced in his first government statement a statutory minimum wage of twelve euros from 2022 as necessary in a rich country, to lift low wages for up to ten million workers; he did not say it should equal basic living costs.

unions-good.rationale: Named precarious work without collective agreements as an injustice to fix and, at Davos, cited unions working hand in hand with business and politics on training.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Said Germany is a country of immigration and welcomes those who want to work; but in 2023 he also called for deporting more rejected applicants faster and limiting irregular migration.

free-trade.rationale: At Davos he pressed for new free-trade agreements (Mercosur, India, Indonesia), said Europe remains open for international trade and warned that protectionism hinders competition and innovation.

nation-first.rationale: Said nationalism and isolation will not solve today's challenges and that German policy cannot be limited to pursuing its interests with no regard for others.

limit-growth.rationale: Said Germany will stay a strong manufacturing country while becoming climate-neutral, and told the UN that a trade-off between climate action and development will not work; he does not discuss limiting growth as such.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Called the climate-neutral transformation the fundamental task of the century and set climate neutrality by 2045, 80% renewable power by 2030 and 2% of land for wind power, with law priority for renewables.

expand-nuclear.rationale: At Davos he said the future belongs solely to renewables, for cost, environmental and security reasons; he extended the last three plants only to April 2023, as an energy-crisis measure.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Said protectionism is detrimental and local-content discrimination against European firms must not occur; he offered to discuss an industrial tariff agreement with the US rather than raise tariffs.

state-directs-investment.rationale: At Davos he described state subsidies bringing hydrogen prices down for industry, state-led grid and wind-power priority, the EU Chips Act as a model for key technologies, and more flexible state-aid rules.

one-party-rule.rationale: Praised citizens who freed themselves from dictatorship and one-party rule and called authoritarian regimes a challenge to democratic order.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Condemned Russia's war to seize Ukraine as imperialism and rejected moving borders by force.

universal-morality.rationale: Held that Germany must respect and defend human rights at all times and in all places, as reflecting the deepest need of every person.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Said Germany's history makes it a permanent task to defend the existence and security of the state of Israel, and he spoke of solidarity with the Jewish state of Israel.

class-collaboration.rationale: Praised the broad consensus between business, employees and politics, and trade unions and employers working together, and called for respect across class lines rather than condescension.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Declared never again racism as the core lesson of German history.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: The citizenship law his government passed lets naturalised people keep their original citizenship, so they no longer have to give up part of their identity.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Declared never again racism and said human rights apply regardless of origin.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Told the UN that human rights belong to everyone, no matter where they come from, what they believe and whom they love.

population-transfer.rationale: Condemned Russian war crimes and deportations and said human rights apply to everyone regardless of origin; Germany took in millions of refugees.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: The citizenship reform he backed cut the required residence from eight to five years (three for outstanding integration), against a ten-year minimum.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: In Prague he proposed moving to majority voting in foreign and tax policy, said even the EU treaties are not set in stone and that each European nation state alone is too small.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Called the transatlantic partnership and NATO central to Germany's security and pushed to strengthen NATO's European pillar.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: The law he backed grants German citizenship at birth to children of non-citizens when a parent has lived legally in Germany for more than five years.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Told the UN that Germany is the second-largest donor to the UN system and of humanitarian aid, backs climate finance (EUR 6 billion in 2022) and a global food-security alliance; he framed these as obligations Germany has entered into.

collective-defense.rationale: Said Germany will defend every centimetre of NATO territory and honour NATO's pledge that an attack on one ally is an attack on all.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Called Russia's annexation of Crimea and Ukrainian land after sham referendums unlawful and demanded Russia withdraw its troops.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: At Munich he named 'never again fascism, racism or a war of aggression' as the lesson Germany draws, and as the duty of Germany as a liberal democracy.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Told the UN that Germany betrayed all civilized values with the murder of six million Jews, an act without parallel.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Said human rights apply to everyone no matter whom they love, which excludes criminalising same-sex relations.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Condemned Putin for poisoning and murdering dissidents and cracking down on civil society.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: At his 2021 swearing-in the Bundestag record says he took the oath without the religious affirmation 'So wahr mir Gott helfe', which Article 56 permits; one act, so low confidence.

social-market-economy.rationale: Pairs reliance on market, competition and innovation (emissions trading, free-trade agreements) with a state safety net: citizen's income, child allowance and energy-price caps for households.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Created a EUR 100 billion special fund for the Bundeswehr (written into the Basic Law) and committed Germany to spending two percent of GDP on defence.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Anchors German security in NATO against Russia and calls transatlantic partnership central, while rejecting a world split into blocs.

racial-franchise.rationale: The citizenship law his government passed gives naturalisation and the vote on equal terms, and bars racist attitudes as grounds against it.

rent-control.rationale: His first government statement announced extending the rent cap until 2029, saying greater fairness was needed between tenants and landlords.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Listed work without a collective agreement among the grievances his government would remedy, while also legislating a statutory minimum wage, so support for bargaining as the wage-setter is partial.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Pledged to bring those who commit war crimes in Ukraine to justice and said Germany is doing everything to support the International Criminal Court.

close-ties-china.rationale: Called the transatlantic partnership central and described China as partner, competitor and rival, to be handled by diversifying partnerships.

multipolar-world.rationale: Said the rise of Asia, Africa and Latin America deserves a stronger political voice and wants the multipolar world to stay multilateral, though he treats multipolarity partly as a fact.

civilians-legitimate-targets.rationale: Called Russia's actions in Mariupol, Bucha and Irpin war crimes and said Hamas's killing of civilians was inhuman.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: The citizenship law his government passed sets residence and integration criteria with no ethnic or racial test, and treats racist attitudes as grounds to refuse naturalisation.

remove-other-ethnic-groups-from-country.rationale: Declared never again racism and said Germany is a country of immigration where people of non-German roots are entitled to participate fully.

human-caused-global-warming.rationale: Described anthropogenic climate change as the greatest challenge of all, with industrialised countries carrying special responsibility as major emitters.

allow-dual-citizenship.rationale: The reform he championed allows multiple citizenship, which he called a paradigm shift so immigrants no longer have to give up part of their identity.

apologise-for-past-wrongs.rationale: Said Germany's crimes fill Germans with pain and shame and that Germany has started to address its colonial past more thoroughly, including returning artefacts.

armed-resistance-to-occupation.rationale: Said Ukraine must be able to defend itself against Russia's invasion and supplied weapons for that purpose.

notes: Searched economy, government, society, world, ecology and liberty themes in his speeches (Zeitenwende, Prague, Davos, UN 2022-24, Munich 2024-25, Bundestag statements on Israel and the 2021 programme). Statements on abortion, drugs, the debt brake, healthcare, tax and many liberty topics have no recorded position of his in these texts and stay null.
